purpose: Frozen structural snapshot used to prove Afyx Graph keeps the analysis behaviour of the pre-independence implementation.
frozen_from_description: Last implementation before the independence cutover (Afyx Graph 1.0.0 engine with the original product surface). Built from a clean export of that commit and run through scripts/semantic-baseline.mjs --write with AFYX_SEMANTIC_CLI pointing at that build's CLI.
rule: Never refreeze from the independent implementation. A difference is a regression to investigate, not a snapshot to update.
